PC: Prepare the room and patient appropriately for the sedation
Recognize and appropriately manage apnea with airway repositioning and BVM ventilation
Recognize and appropriately manage hypotension with a 20 cc/kg NS bolus
Consider administration of 20 mg of IV lidocaine 1% without epinephrine immediately before propofol to reduce injection-associated pain
MK: Determine if patient is appropriate for ED sedation
Explain why not to give an IV opiate with propofol (airway loss, hypotension, etc.)
SBP: Perform a pre-sedation “time out” with RN, guardian and procedure performing physician present
ICS: Obtain verbal consent from the guardian/parent of the patient
Learner should explain events to mother and patient including: 1. Apnea requiring BVM 2. Hypotension requiring fluids
